scope: One fixed single-gun infantry-screen correction on the exact accepted native rescue input. This establishes tactical victory, not successful captive rescue or a complete opening campaign.

cause.baseline: Nineteen exclusive gun moves advanced two doctors into contact while all ten noncrew infantry remained at their arrival positions, 13.15 to 18.38 cells from the gun.
cause.candidate: A single operational gun uses the existing coastal screen controller from its first snapshot. Multiple operational guns retain staged arrival movement. Contact, fire and care decisions are unchanged.

remainingRescueFailure.description: All three living captives at the accepted prefix die from ordinary bleeding during the approach. Actual settlement retains these deaths. No health or bleeding values were edited.

baseline.campaignReference: Same accepted input and recorded orders, per-action synchronization without midpoint save

candidate.campaignReference: Same accepted input and recorded orders, per-action synchronization without midpoint save

nativeReplays.campaignComparison: Per-action synchronization versus per-action synchronization; a single terminal sync timestamps civilian events differently.

sourceComparison.sourceHashMethod: Baseline runtime imported bytes; candidate source files hashed after its one execution and checked against the launch diff. Candidate observer loader was passed with --import instead of --loader, so it did not record runtime bytes. No controller rerun.

regression.before: One failure: no infantry move while the single gun can advance.
regression.after: All four staged-battery tests passed, including crowded multiple guns, current crew selection, usable stance and the new native first-contact/finite-ammo/replay check.

failure.cause: Released captive126 died from ordinary bleeding before native victory; all three captured survivors died in the same way.

sourceMethod.method: Loaded original bytes and end bytes match frozen commit blobs; initial filesystem hash sweep included only .js/.mjs.

fullOpeningValidation.failedObserverLaunch: A prior loader compile failure occurred before any test/campaign action; fixed external duplicate wrapping, then one complete actual execution.
